inference_rules.SetUnionRule: Merge elements from {first_set} and {second_set} to form a new set {set_name}.
inference_rules.SetIntersectionRule: Set {set_name} consists of elements that belong to both {first_set} and {second_set}.
inference_rules.SetDifferenceRule: Set {set_name} is formed by removing elements of {second_set} from {first_set}.
inference_rules.BagAdditiveUnionRule: Merge elements from {first_set} and {second_set} by adding their quantities to get {set_name}.
inference_rules.BagIntersectionRule: {set_name} consists of elements that appear in both {first_set} and {second_set}, with quantities being the minimum of the two sets.
inference_rules.BagDifferenceRule: Subtract {second_set} from {first_set} to get the remaining elements (with corresponding quantity reduction) forming {set_name}.

TupleChooseRule.base: Select {size} elements from {operation_obj} to form an arrangement {obj_name}{optional}.

SetBagChooseSequence.base: Select {size} elements from {operation_obj} to form a sequence {obj_name}{optional}.

BagChoose.base: Select elements from {operation_obj} to get {obj_name}(respecting multiplicities).

SetChooseRule.base: Select {size} elements from {operation_obj} to form a subset {obj_name}{optional}.

Sequence.base: Arrange the selected elements into a sequence.

BagPartitionRule.base: Partition {operation_obj} into {size} disjoint subsets (empty subsets allowed){optional}.

SetPartitionRule.base: Partition {operation_obj} into {size} disjoint subsets (empty subsets allowed){optional}.

constraint_descriptions.BagChooseSizeConstraint: The total number of elements in {bag_choose} must be {comparator} {param}.
constraint_descriptions.ComposeSizeConstraint: The size of the {index}th subset must be {comparator}  {comparator}{param}.
constraint_descriptions.BagComposeCountSizeConstraint: The number of {entity} in the {index}th subset must be {comparator} {param}.

PredecessorConstraint.positive: Sequence {sequence} must contain {entity1} and {entity2} such that {entity1} is immediately before {entity2}.
PredecessorConstraint.negative: Sequence {sequence} does not have {entity1} immediately before {entity2} if both are present.

LessThanConstraint.positive: Sequence {sequence} must contain {entity1} and {entity2} such that {entity1} comes before {entity2} (not necessarily immediately).
LessThanConstraint.negative: Sequence {sequence} does not have {entity1} before {entity2} (immediately or not) if both are present.

NextToConstraint.positive: Sequence {sequence} must contain {entity1} and {entity2} such that they are adjacent.
NextToConstraint.negative: Sequence {sequence} does not have {entity1} and {entity2} adjacent if both are present.

TogetherConstraint.positive: Entities ({entities}) must be together in sequence {sequence} if any are present.
TogetherConstraint.negative: Sequence {sequence} contains at least two of the entities ({entities}) and they are not together.

PredecessorBagConstraint.positive: There is a pair of {entity1} and {entity2} in sequence {sequence} such that {entity1} is immediately before {entity2}.
PredecessorBagConstraint.negative: Sequence {sequence} does not have any {entity1} immediately before any {entity2} ({sequence} that contain only {entity1} or only {entity2} or none of them are also allowed).

LessThanBagConstraint.positive: There is a pair of {entity1} and {entity2} in sequence {sequence} such that {entity1} comes before {entity2} (not necessarily immediately).
LessThanBagConstraint.negative: Sequence {sequence} does not have any {entity1} before any {entity2} (immediately or not) ({sequence} that contain only {entity1} or only {entity2} or none of them are also allowed).

NextToBagConstraint.positive: There is a pair of {entity1} and {entity2} in sequence {sequence} such that they are adjacent.
NextToBagConstraint.negative: Sequence {sequence} does not have any {entity1} and {entity2} adjacent ({sequence} that contain only {entity1} or only {entity2} or none of them are also allowed).

count_type.Next_to: {entity1} and {entity2} are adjacent (in any order) {comparator} {count} times

constraint_descriptions.TupleCountSizeConstraint: The number of {count_obj} in {tuple} must be {comparator} {param}.
constraint_descriptions.TupleDedupCountSizeConstraint: In {tuple}, the number of distinct elements belonging to {count_obj} must be {comparator} {param}.

TupleChooseRule.base: How many different arrangements are there for {obj_name}?

SetBagChooseSequence.base: How many different sequences are there for {obj_name}?

ChooseReplaceTuple.base: How many different ways are there to fill {obj_name}?

BagChoose.base: Under the given constraints, how many different selection schemes are there for {obj_name}?

SetChooseRule.base: How many different ways are there to select {obj_name}?

BagPartitionRule.base: How many different partition methods are there?

SetPartitionRule.base: How many different partition methods are there?

general.count: How many different methods are there for {obj_name}?
general.all: Under the above operations and constraints, how many different cases are there in total?

inference_rules.SetUnionRule: 合并 {first_set} 和 {second_set} 中的元素以形成新集合 {set_name}。
inference_rules.SetIntersectionRule: 集合 {set_name} 由既属于 {first_set} 又属于 {second_set} 的元素组成。
inference_rules.SetDifferenceRule: 从 {first_set} 中移除 {second_set} 的元素，形成集合 {set_name}。
inference_rules.BagAdditiveUnionRule: 合并 {first_set} 和 {second_set} 中的元素（数量相加）以得到 {set_name}。
inference_rules.BagIntersectionRule: {set_name} 由同时出现在 {first_set} 和 {second_set} 中的元素组成，其数量取两者的较小值。
inference_rules.BagDifferenceRule: 从 {first_set} 中减去 {second_set} 以得到剩余元素（相应减少数量），形成 {set_name}。

TupleChooseRule.base: 从 {operation_obj} 中选择 {size} 个元素组成排列 {obj_name}{optional}。

SetBagChooseSequence.base: 从 {operation_obj} 中选择 {size} 个元素组成序列 {obj_name}{optional}。

BagChoose.base: 从 {operation_obj} 中选择元素以得到 {obj_name}（考虑重数）。

SetChooseRule.base: 从 {operation_obj} 中选择 {size} 个元素以形成子集 {obj_name}{optional}。

Sequence.base: 将选中的元素排列成一个序列。

BagPartitionRule.base: 将 {operation_obj} 划分为 {size} 个不相交的子集（允许空子集）{optional}。

SetPartitionRule.base: 将 {operation_obj} 划分为 {size} 个不相交的子集（允许空子集）{optional}。

constraint_descriptions.SubsetConstraint: 集合 ({sub}) 是 {sup} 的子集。
constraint_descriptions.ComposeSizeConstraint: 第 {index} 个子集的大小必须 {comparator} {param}。
constraint_descriptions.BagComposeCountSizeConstraint: 第 {index} 个子集中 {entity} 的数量必须  {comparator} {param}。

PredecessorConstraint.positive: 序列 {sequence} 必须包含 {entity1} 和 {entity2}，且 {entity1} 紧挨在 {entity2} 之前。
PredecessorConstraint.negative: 如果 {entity1} 和 {entity2} 都存在，则序列 {sequence} 中 {entity1} 不得紧挨在 {entity2} 之前。

LessThanConstraint.positive: 序列 {sequence} 必须包含 {entity1} 和 {entity2}，且 {entity1} 在 {entity2} 之前（不一定紧邻）。
LessThanConstraint.negative: 如果 {entity1} 和 {entity2} 都存在，则序列 {sequence} 中 {entity1} 不得在 {entity2} 之前（无论是否紧邻）。

NextToConstraint.positive: 序列 {sequence} 必须包含 {entity1} 和 {entity2}，且它们相邻。
NextToConstraint.negative: 如果 {entity1} 和 {entity2} 都存在，则序列 {sequence} 中它们不得相邻。

TogetherConstraint.positive: 如果实体 ({entities}) 存在，它们必须在序列 {sequence} 中在一起。
TogetherConstraint.negative: 序列 {sequence} 包含至少两个实体 ({entities}) 且它们不在一起。

PredecessorBagConstraint.positive: 序列 {sequence} 中存在一对 {entity1} 和 {entity2}，使得 {entity1} 紧挨在 {entity2} 之前。
PredecessorBagConstraint.negative: 序列 {sequence} 中不存在任何 {entity1} 紧挨在任何 {entity2} 之前（允许序列仅包含 {entity1} 或仅包含 {entity2} 或都不包含）。

LessThanBagConstraint.positive: 序列 {sequence} 中存在一对 {entity1} 和 {entity2}，使得 {entity1} 在 {entity2} 之前（不一定紧邻）。
LessThanBagConstraint.negative: 序列 {sequence} 中不存在任何 {entity1} 在任何 {entity2} 之前（无论是否紧邻）（允许序列仅包含 {entity1} 或仅包含 {entity2} 或都不包含）。

NextToBagConstraint.positive: 序列 {sequence} 中存在一对 {entity1} 和 {entity2}，使得它们相邻。
NextToBagConstraint.negative: 序列 {sequence} 中不存在任何 {entity1} 和 {entity2} 相邻（允许序列仅包含 {entity1} 或仅包含 {entity2} 或都不包含）。

count_type.Next_to: {entity1} 和 {entity2} 相邻（任意顺序）的次数 {comparator} {count}
count_type.Predecessor: {entity1} 紧随其后是 {entity2} 的次数 {comparator} {count}
count_type.Less_than: {entity1} 后面跟着 {entity2}（允许间隔）的次数 {comparator} {count}

constraint_descriptions.TupleDedupCountSizeConstraint: 在 {tuple} 中，属于 {count_obj} 的不同元素的数量必须 {comparator} {param}。
constraint_descriptions.QuantifiedConstraint: 对 {target} 中的每个 part，都有 |part| {comparator} {value}。

ChooseReplaceTuple.base: 有多少种不同的方式来填充 {obj_name}？

BagChoose.base: 在给定约束下，{obj_name} 有多少种不同的选择方案？

SetChooseRule.base: 有多少种不同的方式选择 {obj_name}？

CARD_EN.story_template:
Suppose we are playing with a collection of labeled cards, each marked with a capital letter.
We select, group, and arrange these cards following certain rules.

types.set: We have a pile of distinct cards {set_name}: {description}.
types.bag: We have a deck of cards {set_name} (duplicates possible): {description}.

inference_rules.SetUnionRule: Combine the cards from pile {first_set} and pile {second_set} into a new pile {set_name}.
inference_rules.SetIntersectionRule: Let {set_name} be the cards that appear in both pile {first_set} and pile {second_set}.
inference_rules.SetDifferenceRule: Form pile {set_name} by taking {first_set} and discarding any cards found in {second_set}.
inference_rules.BagAdditiveUnionRule: Shuffle all cards from deck {first_set} and deck {second_set} together to form {set_name}.
inference_rules.BagIntersectionRule: {set_name} consists of cards common to both decks {first_set} and {second_set} (taking the smaller count).
inference_rules.BagDifferenceRule: Remove the cards of {second_set} from {first_set} to leave the remaining deck {set_name}.

TupleChooseRule.base: Draw {size} cards from {operation_obj} and line them up to form {obj_name}{optional}.
TupleChooseRule.replace: (you can draw the same card multiple times by putting it back)
TupleChooseRule.noreplace: (once a card is drawn, it cannot be used again)

SetBagChooseSequence.base: Draw {size} cards from {operation_obj} and line them up to form {obj_name}{optional}.
SetBagChooseSequence.replace: (you can draw the same card multiple times by putting it back)
SetBagChooseSequence.noreplace: (once a card is drawn, it cannot be used again)

BagChoose.base: Select a hand of cards from {operation_obj} to form {obj_name}(considering multiplicities).

SetChooseRule.base: Pick {size} cards from {operation_obj} to form a hand {obj_name}{optional}.

Sequence.base: Arrange these cards in a line.

BagPartitionRule.base: Deal the cards of {operation_obj} into {size} separate piles (piles can be empty){optional}.

SetPartitionRule.base: Distribute the cards of {operation_obj} into {size} separate groups (groups can be empty){optional}.

constraint_descriptions.DisjointConstraint: Pile {first_set} has no common cards with pile {second_set}.
constraint_descriptions.SubsetConstraint: Every card in pile ({sub}) is also found in {sup}.
constraint_descriptions.BagChooseSizeConstraint: The total number of cards in the hand {bag_choose} must be {comparator} {param}.
constraint_descriptions.ComposeSizeConstraint: The number of cards in the {index}th pile must be {comparator} {param}.
constraint_descriptions.BagComposeCountSizeConstraint: The count of card {entity} in the {index}th pile must be {comparator} {param}.

PredecessorConstraint.positive: In the row {sequence}, there is at least one instance where card {entity1} is placed immediately to the left of card {entity2}.
PredecessorConstraint.negative: In the row {sequence}, card {entity1} cannot be placed immediately to the left of card {entity2} (if they are present).

LessThanConstraint.positive: In the row {sequence}, there is at least one instance where card {entity1} appears to the left of card {entity2}.
LessThanConstraint.negative: In the row {sequence}, card {entity1} cannot be placed to the left of card {entity2} (if they are present).

NextToConstraint.positive: In the row {sequence}, there is at least one instance where card {entity1} and card {entity2} are placed side-by-side.
NextToConstraint.negative: In the row {sequence}, card {entity1} and card {entity2} cannot be placed side-by-side (if they are present).

TogetherConstraint.positive: The cards ({entities}) must be kept together as a block in the row {sequence} if any of them appear.
TogetherConstraint.negative: The cards ({entities}) are NOT allowed to be kept together as a single block in {sequence} (zero or single appearances are viewed as together).

count_type.Next_to: card {entity1} is side-by-side with card {entity2} {comparator} {count} times
count_type.Predecessor: card {entity1} is immediately followed by card {entity2} {comparator} {count} times
count_type.Less_than: card {entity1} appears to the left of card {entity2} {comparator} {count} times

constraint_descriptions.TupleCountSizeConstraint: The number of {count_obj} cards in the row {tuple} must be {comparator} {param}.
constraint_descriptions.TupleIndexEqConstraint: The card at position {index} of the row {tuple} {positive_text}is {entity}.
constraint_descriptions.TupleDedupCountSizeConstraint: In the row {tuple}, the number of distinct cards from the set {count_obj} must be {comparator} {param}.

TupleChooseRule.base: How many different ways can we arrange these cards in a row?

SetBagChooseSequence.base: How many different sequences of cards can be formed?

ChooseReplaceTuple.base: How many different ways can we fill the empty slots?

BagChoose.base: How many different hands of cards can be drawn for {obj_name}?

SetChooseRule.base: How many ways can we select a hand of cards for {obj_name}?

BagPartitionRule.base: How many ways can we deal the cards into piles?

SetPartitionRule.base: How many ways can we distribute the cards?

general.count: What is the total number of distinct arrangements/selections for {obj_name}?

ending_phrases.polite: Please calculate the number of valid outcomes for {obj_name}.

CARD_CH.story_template:
假设我们正在使用一组标有大写字母的卡片进行游戏。
我们将根据特定的规则对这些卡片进行选择、分组和排列。

types.set: 我们有一堆互不相同的卡片 {set_name}，包含：{description}。
types.bag: 我们有一副卡片 {set_name}（可能包含重复卡片），包含：{description}。

inference_rules.SetUnionRule: 将卡片堆 {first_set} 和卡片堆 {second_set} 中的卡片合并，组成一个新卡片堆 {set_name}。
inference_rules.SetIntersectionRule: 令 {set_name} 为同时出现在卡片堆 {first_set} 和卡片堆 {second_set} 中的卡片集合。
inference_rules.SetDifferenceRule: 从卡片堆 {first_set} 中除去所有在卡片堆 {second_set} 中出现的卡片，得到卡片堆 {set_name}。
inference_rules.BagAdditiveUnionRule: 将卡片组 {first_set} 和卡片组 {second_set} 中的所有卡片混合在一起，组成 {set_name}。
inference_rules.BagIntersectionRule: {set_name} 由卡片组 {first_set} 和 {second_set} 中共有的卡片组成（数量取两者中的较小值）。
inference_rules.BagDifferenceRule: 从卡片组 {first_set} 中减去卡片组 {second_set} 中的对应卡片，得到剩余的卡片组 {set_name}。

TupleChooseRule.base: 从 {operation_obj} 中抽取 {size} 张卡片并摆放成一排，组成 {obj_name}{optional}。
TupleChooseRule.replace: （允许放回抽样，即同一张卡片可以被多次抽取）
TupleChooseRule.noreplace: （不放回抽样，即每张卡片只能使用一次）

SetBagChooseSequence.base: 从 {operation_obj} 中抽取 {size} 张卡片并排列成一排，组成 {obj_name}{optional}。
SetBagChooseSequence.replace: （允许放回抽样，即同一张卡片可以被多次抽取）
SetBagChooseSequence.noreplace: （不放回抽样，即每张卡片只能使用一次）

BagChoose.base: 从 {operation_obj} 中抽取一组卡片构成手牌 {obj_name}(存在相同的卡片)。

SetChooseRule.base: 从 {operation_obj} 中选取 {size} 张卡片构成手牌 {obj_name}{optional}。

Sequence.base: 将这些卡片排列成一排。
Sequence.ordered: 需考虑卡片的排列顺序
Sequence.uniqueness: 所有卡片必须互不相同

BagPartitionRule.base: 将 {operation_obj} 中的卡片分配到 {size} 个不同的堆中（允许出现空堆）{optional}。

SetPartitionRule.base: 将 {operation_obj} 中的卡片分配到 {size} 个不同的组中（允许出现空组）{optional}。

constraint_descriptions.DisjointConstraint: 卡片堆 {first_set} 与卡片堆 {second_set} 没有共同的卡片。
constraint_descriptions.SubsetConstraint: 卡片堆 ({sub}) 中的每一张卡片都可以在 {sup} 中找到。
constraint_descriptions.BagChooseSizeConstraint: 手牌 {bag_choose} 中的卡片总数必须 {comparator} {param}。
constraint_descriptions.ComposeSizeConstraint: 第 {index} 堆中的卡片数量必须 {comparator} {param}。
constraint_descriptions.BagComposeCountSizeConstraint: 第 {index} 堆中卡片 {entity} 的数量必须  {comparator} {param}。

PredecessorConstraint.positive: 在排列 {sequence} 中，至少存在一处满足卡片 {entity1} 紧邻在卡片 {entity2} 的左侧。
PredecessorConstraint.negative: 在排列 {sequence} 中，卡片 {entity1} 不能紧邻在卡片 {entity2} 的左侧（如果这两张卡片同时存在）。

LessThanConstraint.positive: 在排列 {sequence} 中，至少存在一处满足卡片 {entity1} 出现在卡片 {entity2} 的左侧（不一定紧邻）。
LessThanConstraint.negative: 在排列 {sequence} 中，卡片 {entity1} 不能出现在卡片 {entity2} 的左侧（如果这两张卡片同时存在）。

NextToConstraint.positive: 在排列 {sequence} 中，至少存在一处满足卡片 {entity1} 与卡片 {entity2} 相邻摆放。
NextToConstraint.negative: 在排列 {sequence} 中，卡片 {entity1} 与卡片 {entity2} 不能相邻摆放（如果这两张卡片同时存在）。

TogetherConstraint.positive: 在排列 {sequence} 中，如果卡片组 ({entities}) 中的任何卡片出现，它们必须作为一个连续的整体排在一起。
TogetherConstraint.negative: 在排列 {sequence} 中，卡片组 ({entities}) 不允许作为一个连续的整体排在一起（未出现或仅出现一张的情况视为“在一起”）。

count_type.Next_to: 卡片 {entity1} 与卡片 {entity2} 相邻的次数 {comparator} {count}
count_type.Predecessor: 卡片 {entity1} 紧随其后是卡片 {entity2} 的次数 {comparator} {count}
count_type.Less_than: 卡片 {entity1} 出现在卡片 {entity2} 左侧的次数 {comparator} {count}

constraint_descriptions.TupleCountSizeConstraint: 在排列 {tuple} 中，{count_obj} 类卡片的数量必须 {comparator} {param}。
constraint_descriptions.TupleIndexEqConstraint: 排列 {tuple} 的第 {index} 个位置上的卡片 {positive_text}是 {entity}。
constraint_descriptions.TupleDedupCountSizeConstraint: 在排列 {tuple} 中，属于集合 {count_obj} 且互不相同的卡片种类数必须 {comparator} {param}。

TupleChooseRule.base: 共有多少种不同的方式将这些卡片排列成一排？

SetBagChooseSequence.base: 总共可以形成多少种不同的卡片序列？

ChooseReplaceTuple.base: 共有多少种不同的方式来填满这些空位？

BagChoose.base: 对于 {obj_name}，可以抽取多少种不同的手牌组合？

SetChooseRule.base: 对于 {obj_name}，有多少种选取手牌的方式？

BagPartitionRule.base: 有多少种将卡片分配到不同堆中的方式？

SetPartitionRule.base: 有多少种分配这些卡片的方式？

general.count: 对于 {obj_name}，不同的排列/选择方案总数是多少？

ending_phrases.polite: 请计算 {obj_name} 的有效结果总数。
